title: The Agony in the Garden
alt: Christ kneels in prayer on a rocky hillside as an angel offers the chalice, while Peter, James and John sleep below and soldiers approach in the distance

title: The Scourging at the Pillar
alt: Christ stands bound to a column in a vaulted hall while tormentors strike him with rods and onlookers crowd around

title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
alt: Christ sits bound beneath arches as a kneeling man mockingly offers him a reed and other men press the crown of thorns on his head with sticks

title: Christ Carrying the Cross
alt: Christ bends beneath the weight of the cross as soldiers drive him on and holy women grieve at the left near a city gate

title: The Ascension
alt: The apostles and Mary kneel and gaze upward as only the feet of the ascending Christ remain visible in the clouds above

title: Pentecost
alt: The Holy Spirit as a dove radiates light over Mary and the apostles, who sit and stand with small flames on their heads

title: The Death of the Virgin
alt: Mary lies propped on pillows in a canopied bed, holding a candle, as the apostles gather around her in prayer, with censer, book and processional cross
